newsitem.title: USA: VLSI sees revenue up 10 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: VLSI sees revenue up 10 pct in 1997.

text.p: VLSI Technology Inc expects revenues to rise 10 percent in 1997, Rich Breyer, president of the semiconductor company, said on Wednesday.
"Our 1997 revenue will rise only modestly this year," Breyer told investors at the Hambrecht and Quist Technology Conference in San Francisco.

VLSI is ready to introduce products based on next-generation chipmaking techniques. Breyer said sales would show only modest growth until those products were introduced late this year and early next year.
